modules: 记忆类型与最小模型
定义 Episodic、Semantic、Procedural、Preference 和 Relationship 五类，但先只实现任务所需的 Episodic 与 Semantic 路径。每条记录包含来源、置信度、敏感度、观察时间、更新时间、作用域和过期策略，不允许无来源的模型总结进入长期记忆。
写入、检索与上下文注入
写入区分用户明确确认、任务产物观察和模型推断，推断默认低置信度且不能改变权限。检索按任务目标、项目、时间和敏感度过滤，Context Pack 记录入选原因与预算；召回失败或置信度不足时明确说不知道。
为什么召回与记忆浏览
记忆浏览器按类型、项目、时间和敏感度展示记录，详情页说明何时、从哪条证据写入，为什么在本次任务被召回。用户能纠正值、标记敏感、删除记录或缩小作用域；纠正产生新版本，不覆盖被撤销的历史证据。
敏感隔离与跨项目边界
敏感记忆使用单独作用域和加密字段，不进入普通任务摘要、推送或诊断导出。跨账户、跨项目建立硬隔离，测试要证明错误记忆可纠正、敏感内容不进入不应出现的上下文、删除后不再被召回。
Memory classes and minimal model

Define Episodic, Semantic, Procedural, Preference, and Relationship classes, but implement only the Episodic and Semantic paths tasks need first. Each record has provenance, confidence, sensitivity, observation time, update time, scope, and expiry. Unsourced model summaries never enter long-term memory.
Write, retrieval, and context injection

Separate explicit user confirmation, task-artifact observation, and model inference; inference starts low-confidence and cannot alter authority. Retrieval filters by objective, project, time, and sensitivity, and Context Pack records selection reasons and budget. Say unknown when recall fails or confidence is insufficient.
Why recalled and memory browser

The memory browser shows records by class, project, time, and sensitivity. Detail explains when and from which evidence it was written and why this task recalled it. Users can correct values, mark sensitivity, delete, or narrow scope. Corrections create versions and never overwrite revoked evidence.
Sensitive isolation and project boundaries

Sensitive memory uses separate scopes and encrypted fields and never enters ordinary task summaries, push, or diagnostic export. Enforce hard account and project isolation. Tests prove wrong memories are correctable, sensitive data stays out of prohibited context, and deleted records are no longer recalled.
冲突检测与显式覆盖
同一事实出现不同值、不同来源或不同时间时标记冲突，不按“最后写入”静默覆盖。根据来源权威性、确认状态和时效提出候选，由用户或明确规则选择；被覆盖记录保留历史、原因和可回滚引用。
遗忘传播与缓存失效
删除请求先标记不可检索，再传播到向量索引、摘要缓存、Context Pack 缓存和相关设备。传播失败显示未完成设备与原因，重试幂等；确认所有副本失效后才显示“已遗忘”，敏感记忆优先进入短 TTL 与隔离存储。
完整导出与可迁移格式
导出包含记忆值、类型、来源、版本、时间、敏感标记、纠正历史和遗忘状态，使用可读格式与校验清单。用户可以选择全量导出或按项目导出；导出文件加密、短期有效，不包含原始凭据。
记忆投毒与权限边界
网页、附件和外部邮件中的指令不得直接写入记忆，更不能通过记忆扩大权限。检测来源伪造、重复洗白、越权建议和隐藏提示，隔离可疑记录并保留证据；验收证明恶意内容不能获得权限，用户能理解记忆为何变化。
Conflict detection and explicit override

Mark conflicts when one fact has different values, sources, or times; never silently apply last-write-wins. Propose options by source authority, confirmation, and freshness, then let the user or an explicit rule decide. Overridden records retain history, reason, and rollback reference.
Forgetting propagation and cache invalidation

A deletion request first becomes non-retrievable, then propagates to vector indexes, summary caches, Context Pack caches, and relevant devices. Failure shows unfinished devices and reasons; retry is idempotent. Show Forgotten only after every replica is invalidated. Sensitive memory receives short TTL and isolated storage.
Complete export and portable format

Export includes value, class, source, version, time, sensitivity, correction history, and forgetting state in a readable format with a manifest. Users can export all or one project. Export files are encrypted and short-lived, with no raw credentials.
Memory poisoning and authority boundary

Instructions in pages, attachments, or external email never write memory directly or expand authority through memory. Detect forged provenance, laundering, privileged suggestions, and hidden prompts; quarantine suspicious records with evidence. Acceptance proves malicious content gains no authority and users understand why memory changed.
轨迹采集与安全重放
记录任务步骤、工具调用、输入摘要、结果、失败类别和必要截图，敏感字段脱敏。重放使用隔离环境和 fake tools，禁止真实外部副作用；轨迹必须获得用户同意并可按项目删除，不能把每次任务都永久保存。
技能 manifest 与权限声明
技能声明输入、输出、所需连接器、文件范围、动作风险、版本、作者、评估引用和签名。manifest 不能申请超出父任务的权限，运行时按最小能力注入；缺失依赖时明确失败，不自动扩大 scope。
候选生成与评估集
从成功与失败轨迹提炼候选方法，生成差异说明、期望收益和风险。评估集覆盖代表性任务、边界样本和失败样本，固定输入与评分器；候选在隔离环境与 baseline 同任务对照，禁止挑选有利样本。
Shadow 运行与污染防护
Shadow 只生成结果和评估指标，不改变生产技能、不执行真实外部动作。隔离训练与评估样本，检测记忆污染、提示注入和重复试跑造成的过拟合；UI 展示候选差异、权限和收益，未过门不得进入晋升。
Trajectory capture and safe replay

Record task steps, tool calls, input digests, results, failure class, and necessary screenshots with sensitive fields redacted. Replay uses an isolated environment and fake tools with no real external effects. Capture requires user consent and supports project deletion; not every task is stored forever.
Skill manifest and authority declaration

A skill declares inputs, outputs, connectors, file scope, action risk, version, author, evaluation reference, and signature. The manifest cannot request authority beyond the parent task, and runtime injects least capability. Missing dependencies fail visibly instead of silently widening scope.
Candidate generation and evaluation set

Derive candidate methods from successful and failed trajectories with a difference statement, expected gain, and risk. Evaluation sets cover representative, boundary, and failure tasks with fixed inputs and scorers. Compare candidate and baseline on the same isolated task; never cherry-pick favorable samples.
Shadow runs and contamination defense

Shadow only produces results and metrics, changing no production skill and causing no real external effect. Isolate training and evaluation samples and detect memory poisoning, prompt injection, and overfitting from repeated runs. The UI shows candidate differences, authority, and gain; candidates below the gate cannot advance.
晋升状态机与权限交集
实现 Draft → Evaluated → Shadow → Canary → Promoted → Rolled back 状态机，每次迁移需要可复查证据。有效权限等于父任务、用户 Mandate、技能声明和环境策略的交集；任何一项缩小都会立即生效，自进化不能成为提权路径。
版本、签名与运行时选择
技能版本不可变并签名，运行时按任务、能力和评估结果选择，不默认使用最新候选。回滚只切换指针并保留事件，旧版本仍可验证；签名无效、评估过期或 manifest 变化时拒绝加载。
技能界面与用户解释
技能页展示当前版本、候选差异、所需权限、评估集、Shadow/Canary 结果、晋升原因和回滚入口。用户能理解“为什么采用新方法”以及它多做了什么；没有评估证据或权限说明的候选不能展示为可晋升。
完整晋升、回滚与 Stage 5 发布
至少完成一个真实技能的晋升案例，经过 Shadow 和小范围 Canary 后提升，再主动演练回滚并记录影响范围。安全报告证明无权限扩大、无真实副作用泄漏、无评估污染；Stage 5 退出条件不全时不得进入多设备阶段。
Promotion state machine and authority intersection

Implement Draft → Evaluated → Shadow → Canary → Promoted → Rolled back, requiring reviewable evidence at each transition. Effective authority is the intersection of parent task, user Mandate, skill manifest, and environment policy. Any reduction applies immediately; self-evolution is never a privilege path.
Versions, signatures, and runtime selection

Skill versions are immutable and signed. Runtime selects by task, capability, and evaluation result, never defaulting to the newest candidate. Rollback only switches a pointer and preserves events; old versions remain verifiable. Reject invalid signatures, stale evaluations, or changed manifests.
Skill UI and user explanation

The skill page shows current version, candidate differences, required authority, evaluation set, Shadow and Canary results, promotion reason, and rollback entry. Users understand why the new method was adopted and what it adds. Candidates without evaluation evidence or authority rationale cannot appear promotable.
Full promotion, rollback, and Stage 5 release

Complete at least one real skill promotion from Shadow to limited Canary, then deliberately rehearse rollback and record impact scope. The safety report proves no privilege expansion, no leaked real effect, and no evaluation contamination. Incomplete Stage 5 exits block the multi-device stage.
